## Origin

Which of these wrote this change:

- [ ] Human — the operator, directly
- [ ] Attended agent — a model in a live session, someone watching
- [ ] Unattended agent — a model started by a schedule or event, nobody watching
- [ ] Machine — a deterministic pipeline or generator, no model involved
- [ ] External — a contributor outside the organisation

## Closes

Closes #<issue number>, or "Closes nothing" if this PR doesn't close an issue.
